import json
import time
from pathlib import Path
import joblib
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.naive_bayes import MultinomialNB
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

CLASSES = ["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]


def _make_vectors():
    return [
        TfidfVectorizer(analyzer="word", ngram_range=(1, 3), sublinear_tf=True,
                        max_features=120000, min_df=1),
        TfidfVectorizer(analyzer="char", ngram_range=(2, 6), sublinear_tf=True,
                        max_features=170000, min_df=1),
        TfidfVectorizer(analyzer="char_wb", ngram_range=(3, 7), sublinear_tf=True,
                        max_features=170000, min_df=1),
    ]


def _ordered(model, texts, vector):
    raw = model.predict_proba(vector.transform(texts))
    out = np.zeros((len(texts), 3), dtype=float)
    for j, cls in enumerate(model.classes_):
        out[:, CLASSES.index(str(cls))] = raw[:, j]
    return out


def _all_probs(vectors, models, texts, weights, temperature, bias):
    mats = [_ordered(m, texts, v) for v, m in zip(vectors, models)]
    p = np.zeros((len(texts), 3), dtype=float)
    for w, q in zip(weights, mats):
        p += float(w) * q
    p = np.clip(p, 1e-12, 1.0)
    z = np.log(p) / float(temperature) + np.asarray(bias, dtype=float)[None, :]
    z -= z.max(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    e = np.exp(z)
    return e / e.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)


def train(data_dir, artifact_dir, budget_seconds, seed):
    start = time.time()
    data_dir = Path(data_dir)
    artifact_dir = Path(artifact_dir)
    artifact_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fit = pd.read_csv(data_dir / "fit.csv")
    tune = pd.read_csv(data_dir / "tune.csv")
    texts = fit.text.fillna("").astype(str).tolist()
    y = fit.author.astype(str).to_numpy()
    tune_texts = tune.text.fillna("").astype(str).tolist()
    tune_y = tune.author.astype(str).to_numpy()

    vectors = _make_vectors()
    x = [v.fit_transform(texts) for v in vectors]
    models = [
        LogisticRegression(C=2.7, max_iter=600, solver="liblinear", random_state=seed),
        LogisticRegression(C=2.7, max_iter=600, solver="liblinear", random_state=seed),
        LogisticRegression(C=2.7, max_iter=600, solver="liblinear", random_state=seed),
        MultinomialNB(alpha=0.03),
        MultinomialNB(alpha=0.03),
    ]
    models[0].fit(x[0], y)
    models[1].fit(x[1], y)
    models[2].fit(x[2], y)
    models[3].fit(x[0], y)
    models[4].fit(x[1], y)

    trajectory = []
    blends = [
        [0.25, 0.20, 0.20, 0.20, 0.15],
        [0.30, 0.20, 0.20, 0.15, 0.15],
        [0.25, 0.25, 0.20, 0.15, 0.15],
        [0.25, 0.20, 0.25, 0.15, 0.15],
        [0.20, 0.20, 0.20, 0.20, 0.20],
        [0.30, 0.15, 0.20, 0.20, 0.15],
        [0.25, 0.15, 0.25, 0.20, 0.15],
        [0.20, 0.15, 0.25, 0.20, 0.20],
        [0.35, 0.15, 0.20, 0.15, 0.15],
        [0.20, 0.20, 0.25, 0.15, 0.15],
    ]
    temperatures = [0.62, 0.66, 0.68, 0.70, 0.74, 0.78, 0.84]
    biases = [[0.0, 0.0, 0.0], [-0.025, 0.0125, 0.0125],
              [0.0, 0.02, -0.02], [0.0125, 0.0125, -0.025]]
    best = (float("inf"), blends[0], 1.0, [0.0, 0.0, 0.0])
    for weights in blends:
        for temperature in temperatures:
            for bias in biases:
                score = float(log_loss(tune_y, _all_probs(vectors, models, tune_texts,
                                                            weights, temperature, bias),
                                        labels=CLASSES))
                trajectory.append({"stage":"blend_calibration", "weights":weights,
                                   "temperature":temperature, "bias":bias,
                                   "tune_logloss":score, "seconds":time.time()-start})
                if score < best[0]:
                    best = (score, list(weights), temperature, list(bias))

    artifact = {"vectors":vectors, "models":models, "weights":best[1],
                "temperature":best[2], "bias":best[3], "classes":CLASSES}
    joblib.dump(artifact, artifact_dir / "model.joblib")
    loaded = joblib.load(artifact_dir / "model.joblib")
    check = _all_probs(loaded["vectors"], loaded["models"], tune_texts[:8],
                       loaded["weights"], loaded["temperature"], loaded["bias"])
    params = {"architecture":"word_1to3_plus_char_2to6_plus_charwb_3to7_tfidf_logistic_plus_word_and_raw_char_multinomialnb",
              "logistic_C":[2.7,2.7,2.7], "nb_alpha":[0.03,0.03],
              "weights":best[1], "temperature":best[2], "bias":best[3], "seed":seed,
              "schedule":"fit five channels on fit.csv; evaluate 280 blend/calibration settings on tune.csv; serialize selected configuration",
              "tune_loss":best[0], "inner_evaluation":trajectory,
              "elapsed_seconds":time.time()-start, "reload_check_shape":list(check.shape)}
    with open(artifact_dir / "parameters.json", "w") as f:
        json.dump(params, f)
    return params


def predict(artifact_dir, texts):
    a = joblib.load(Path(artifact_dir) / "model.joblib")
    return _all_probs(a["vectors"], a["models"], list(texts), a["weights"],
                      a["temperature"], a["bias"])

from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

CLASSES = ["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]


def _make_vectors():
    return [
        TfidfVectorizer(analyzer="word", ngram_range=(1, 3), sublinear_tf=True,
                        max_features=120000, min_df=1),
        TfidfVectorizer(analyzer="char", ngram_range=(2, 6), sublinear_tf=True,
                        max_features=160000, min_df=1),
        TfidfVectorizer(analyzer="char_wb", ngram_range=(3, 7), sublinear_tf=True,
                        max_features=160000, min_df=1),
        TfidfVectorizer(analyzer="char_wb", ngram_range=(2, 8), sublinear_tf=True,
                        max_features=160000, min_df=1),
    ]


def _ordered(model, vector, texts):
    raw = model.predict_proba(vector.transform(texts))
    out = np.zeros((len(texts), 3), dtype=float)
    for j, cls in enumerate(model.classes_):
        out[:, CLASSES.index(str(cls))] = raw[:, j]
    return out


def _probs(vectors, models, texts, weights, temperature=1.0, bias=None):
    if len(vectors) != len(models) or len(weights) != len(models):
        raise ValueError("vector/model/weight cardinality mismatch")
    mats = [_ordered(m, v, texts) for v, m in zip(vectors, models)]
    p = np.zeros((len(texts), 3), dtype=float)
    for w, q in zip(weights, mats):
        p += float(w) * q
    p = np.clip(p, 1e-12, 1.0)
    z = np.log(p) / float(temperature)
    if bias is not None:
        z += np.asarray(bias, dtype=float)[None, :]
    z -= z.max(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    e = np.exp(z)
    return e / e.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)


def train(data_dir, artifact_dir, budget_seconds, seed):
    start = time.time()
    data_dir = Path(data_dir)
    artifact_dir = Path(artifact_dir)
    artifact_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    fit = pd.read_csv(data_dir / "fit.csv")
    tune = pd.read_csv(data_dir / "tune.csv")
    texts = fit.text.fillna("").astype(str).tolist()
    y = fit.author.astype(str).to_numpy()
    tune_texts = tune.text.fillna("").astype(str).tolist()
    tune_y = tune.author.astype(str).to_numpy()

    vectors = _make_vectors()
    matrices = [v.fit_transform(texts) for v in vectors]
    models = []
    for x in matrices:
        model = LogisticRegression(C=2.3, max_iter=700, solver="liblinear",
                                   random_state=seed)
        model.fit(x, y)
        models.append(model)

    trajectory = []
    blends = [
        [0.25, 0.15, 0.20, 0.40],
        [0.25, 0.15, 0.30, 0.30],
        [0.25, 0.25, 0.10, 0.40],
        [0.25, 0.25, 0.20, 0.30],
        [0.25, 0.25, 0.30, 0.20],
        [0.35, 0.15, 0.10, 0.40],
        [0.35, 0.15, 0.20, 0.30],

        [0.35, 0.25, 0.20, 0.20],
        [0.35, 0.25, 0.30, 0.10],
        [0.45, 0.15, 0.10, 0.30],
        [0.45, 0.25, 0.10, 0.20],
        [1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
    ]
    temperatures = [0.64, 0.68, 0.72, 0.76, 0.84, 0.92, 1.0]
    biases = [
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        [-0.02, 0.01, 0.01],
        [0.02, -0.01, -0.01],
        [0.0, 0.02, -0.02],
        [0.0, -0.02, 0.02],

    best_loss = float("inf")
    best_weights = blends[0]
    best_temperature = 1.0
    best_bias = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
    for weights in blends:
        base = _probs(vectors, models, tune_texts, weights)
        base_loss = float(log_loss(tune_y, base, labels=CLASSES))
        trajectory.append({"stage": "blend", "weights": weights,
                           "temperature": 1.0, "bias": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
                           "tune_logloss": base_loss,
                           "seconds": time.time() - start})
        for temperature in temperatures:
            for bias in biases:
                score = float(log_loss(
                    tune_y,
                    _probs(vectors, models, tune_texts, weights, temperature, bias),
                    labels=CLASSES))
                trajectory.append({"stage": "calibration", "weights": weights,
                                   "temperature": temperature, "bias": bias,
                                   "tune_logloss": score,
                                   "seconds": time.time() - start})
                if score < best_loss:
                    best_loss = score
                    best_weights = list(weights)
                    best_temperature = float(temperature)
                    best_bias = list(bias)

    artifact = {
        "vectors": vectors,
        "models": models,
        "weights": best_weights,
        "temperature": best_temperature,
        "bias": best_bias,
        "classes": CLASSES,
        "cardinality": 4,
    }
    joblib.dump(artifact, artifact_dir / "model.joblib")

    loaded1 = joblib.load(artifact_dir / "model.joblib")
    loaded2 = joblib.load(artifact_dir / "model.joblib")
    probe = tune_texts[: min(16, len(tune_texts))]
    p1 = _probs(loaded1["vectors"], loaded1["models"], probe,
                loaded1["weights"], loaded1["temperature"], loaded1["bias"])
    p2 = _probs(loaded2["vectors"], loaded2["models"], probe,
                loaded2["weights"], loaded2["temperature"], loaded2["bias"])
    if not np.array_equal(p1, p2):
        raise RuntimeError("reload predictions are not deterministic")

    params = {
        "architecture": "word_1to3_plus_char_2to6_plus_charwb_3to7_plus_charwb_2to8_tfidf_logistic",
        "channel_C": [2.3, 2.3, 2.3, 2.3],
        "weights": best_weights,
        "temperature": best_temperature,
        "bias": best_bias,
        "seed": seed,
        "schedule": "fit four TF-IDF logistic channels on fit.csv; evaluate 13 blend settings and 455 calibration settings on tune.csv; serialize selected configuration",
        "tune_loss": best_loss,
        "inner_evaluation": trajectory,
        "elapsed_seconds": time.time() - start,
        "reload_check_shape": list(p1.shape),
        "reload_equal": True,
    }
    with open(artifact_dir / "parameters.json", "w") as f:
        json.dump(params, f)
    return params


def predict(artifact_dir, texts):
